description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Modal' that renders a customizable modal dialog in a React application. The component manages accessibility, positioning, styling, and behavior such as closing on backdrop click or ESC key, with support for dynamic header offset and z-indexing. It uses React portals to render outside the main DOM hierarchy and includes inline CSS styling for layout and responsiveness.
